title: Deployment image uses floating :latest tag
description: The deployment manifest still uses the :latest image tag, making deployments non-reproducible. Different nodes could pull different image versions, and Kubernetes rollback guarantees are defeated because all revisions point to the same tag.
recommended_action: Pin to a specific version tag or digest, e.g. orders-api:v1.0.0 or orders-api@sha256:...

title: Environment variables hardcoded in deployment manifest instead of ConfigMap
evidence:
env:
  - name: PORT
    value: "8080"
  - name: LOG_LEVEL
    value: "info"
description: Configuration values are embedded directly in the deployment manifest. Using a ConfigMap allows configuration changes without modifying the deployment object and supports environment-specific overrides.
recommended_action: Create a ConfigMap and reference values via envFrom: configMapRef or valueFrom: configMapKeyRef

title: Dockerfile final stage uses debian:bookworm-slim — not distroless or scratch
description: The final image stage is based on debian:bookworm-slim, which includes a full Debian userland with shell, package manager, and system utilities. This unnecessarily increases the attack surface. Docker Gate D-04 recommends scratch or a distroless image.
recommended_action: Change to gcr.io/distroless/base-debian12:nonroot or gcr.io/distroless/static:nonroot if no C shared libraries are needed
